text:
```yaml
name: Release Binaries

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and upload binaries
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Crystal
        uses: crystal-lang/setup-crystal@v1
        with:
          crystal: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: shards install

      - name: Build binary
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.os }}" = "windows-latest" ]; then
            crystal build src/noir.cr --release --progress --no-debug --link-flavor static --emit exe
            mv noir.exe noir-${{ matrix.os }}.exe
          else
            crystal build src/noir.cr --release --progress --no-debug --link-flavor static
            mv noir noir-${{ matrix.os }}
          fi

      - name: Upload release asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ${{ github.workspace }}/noir-${{ matrix.os }}${{ matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && '.exe' || '' }}
          asset_name: noir-${{ matrix.os }}${{ matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && '.exe' || '' }}
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream
```
